description: Michigan’s 32nd Senate District consists of the entirety of Benzie, Mason, and Oceana counties, and contains portions of Manistee county and Muskegon County. Uniquely defined by its mix of agriculture, tourism, and manufacturing, the district includes tight-knit communities that range from rural townships and small villages to the urban center of Muskegon along Lake Michigan.
